nature: HUMAN-APPROVED HOUSE-STYLE ENVELOPE — not a rigid production template. Future videos may deviate when the creative reason is explicit.

predecessor.status: preserved as historical predecessor, not overwritten

source_basis.pixel_exact_work: future typography/safe-area analysis should use masters; temporal measurements may use either where editorial equivalence is proven (it is, per SOURCE-PROVENANCE-RECONCILIATION.json)
source_basis.succession: append-only; future human-made/published videos may expand or revise the envelope; this reference is strong evidence of current house practice, not a permanent definition of what VIDTOOLZ may ever become

event_model.doctrine: Three levels; do NOT collapse into one metric; do NOT average A and B; macro cadence alone is not enough — QC must evaluate A AND B AND C.

LEVEL_C_CONTINUOUS_VISUAL_MOTION.note: reference-informed, not a hard requirement; STATIC BACKDROP != STATIC SCREEN

principles.name: ENVELOPE_NOT_TEMPLATE
principles.text: Acceptable ranges and tendencies; deviation permitted with explicit creative reason.

principles.name: PRESENTER_OR_CONTINUOUS_VISUAL_LIFE
principles.text: Presenter presence is a STRONG FINAL-STYLE PATTERN but NOT mandatory for VISUAL_DRAFT. If absent, compensate via proxy/avatar motion, subtle plate motion, push-ins, reframing, evolving graphics, or more frequent Level-B events. No single implementation mandated.
principles.supersedes: Gate-10 divergence resolved by this equivalence principle.

principles.name: MACRO_CADENCE_ALONE_IS_NOT_ENOUGH
principles.text: A draft can pass Level A and still be a slideshow; evaluate B and C too.

principles.name: PRESENTER_SCALE_COMMUNICATES_ATTENTION_PRIORITY
principles.text: Larger on sparse/atmospheric screens, smaller when dense cards are primary (LIKELY pattern). On D4/D5 screens important information must not be occluded by the presenter; observed reference occlusion is not doctrine.

principles.name: MIRRORED_PLATE_IS_PRODUCTION_ARTIFACT
principles.text: Reference artifact, not house-style doctrine. Reusable principle: persistent unboxed presenter + density-aware placement + graphic/backdrop interaction.

principles.name: DESIGNED_INFORMATION_CARD_FIRST_CLASS
principles.text: Approved visual type. Reusable patterns (not mandatory templates): two-column comparison, numbered/list card, labelled concept card, footer/takeaway band, dense synthesis card. Production system should become capable of constructing them deliberately.

principles.name: GRAPHICS_OFTEN_CARRY_ARGUMENT_BUT_NOT_ALWAYS
principles.text: Graphics should often carry part of the argument; EVERY VISUAL MUST EXPLAIN is REJECTED. Balance: EXPLANATION, PROOF, COMPARISON, MOOD, HUMOR, PUNCTUATION.

principles.name: READ_LOOK_RHYTHM
principles.text: Card <-> photoreal/atmospheric alternation as a visual-variety heuristic; strict alternation not required.

principles.name: ONE_ASSET_MULTIPLE_BEATS
principles.text: Strong production principle: push-ins, reframing, crop changes, graphic evolution, treatment changes; a meaningful event does not require a new generated asset. Major efficiency principle.

principles.name: RESTRAINED_PURPOSEFUL_MOTION
principles.text: Slow single-vector motion, subtle drift, natural presenter movement, controlled graphic evolution. No shake/aggressive ramps/constant motion as requirement. Goal: visual life, not motion for its own sake.

principles.name: TYPOGRAPHY_TENDENCIES
principles.text: Hierarchical, short structured text, designed cards, 2-3 line headlines where practical, accent on the rhetorical turn, one primary accent hue per video, full-frame type at thesis/comparison/closing. Long free-floating prose = ATYPICAL, not forbidden. Portrait-readable and safe-area compliant always.

principles.name: ENDINGS_TEND_MORE_DESIGNED
principles.text: Strong tendency: dense synthesis/conclusion card -> hard stop, over generic CTA/outro/decorative close. CTA absence is NOT an absolute rule.

principles.name: HUMOR_PER_VIDEO
principles.text: Per-video creative setting (funny/dry/serious/technical all fit).

principles.name: RESOLUTION_PRODUCTION_RULE
principles.text: 1080x1920 minimum canonical portrait delivery; 2160x3840 allowed when useful/available. Production-quality rule, not creative identity rule.

principles.name: DENSITY_GOVERNS_PACE
principles.text: Denser graphics receive more reading time; do not combine high density with rapid replacement without deliberate creative reason. D0-D5 retained as analysis vocabulary; observed ceiling not mandatory.

principles.name: HARD_CUT_DEFAULT
principles.text: Hard cut is the default house transition; dissolves available but uncommon; no transition variety for energy. Energy from content change, motion, presenter, graphic evolution.

principles.name: NO_MEANINGFUL_VISUAL_EVOLUTION_OVER_10S
principles.text: Advisory warning, triggers review not failure. A >10 s macro backdrop state is permitted when Level-B events or Level-C motion justify it; >10 s with no meaningful evolution is the concern.

principles.name: GENERATION_PRIORITY
principles.text: Do not prioritize indiscriminate generated video. Generated video remains useful when the visual function genuinely requires motion footage.

principles.name: DRAFT_DIAGNOSIS_ACCEPTED
principles.text: Current automated draft is Level-A correct but Level-B/C weak. The fix is MAKE EACH STATE MORE ALIVE AND INFORMATION-BEARING, not more cuts.

principles.name: QC_ADVISORY_FIRST
principles.text: Measured bands activate as REFERENCE_WARNING only; no blocking gates; normal variation is not failure; promotion only after 5-10 productions of evidence.

principles.name: APPEND_ONLY_SUCCESSION
principles.text: Reference succession append-only; three videos are strong evidence of current practice, not a permanent definition.

doctrine: Learn the rhythm of the human VIDTOOLZ videos without turning them into a cage: continuous visual life, argument-bearing graphics, density-aware pacing, restrained hard cuts, hierarchical typography, enough meaningful visual evolution that the programme never becomes inert.
